mentions.name: Nostr-based Quora/StackOverflow alternative
mentions.description: A Q&A platform alternative to Quora and StackOverflow built on Nostr, with portable identity, user-owned data/posts/reputation, the ability to reply from or to any Nostr client, open anti-spam ranking via Web-of-Trust and global pagerank, and zaps/payments weighted more heavily than likes.
mentions.problem: Existing Q&A platforms like Quora and StackOverflow lock users in and take all intellectual property rights over their content.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an alternative for Quora/StackOverflow. It's everything i like about those two platforms but without the lock-in/giving them all intellectual property rights.

evidence.value: I'm working on an alternative for Quora/StackOverflow. It's everything i like about those two platforms but without the lock-in/giving them all intellectual property rights.
